description: Which exchange markets on Cryptohopper receive the daily trend signals (buy when a coin turns long, sell when it turns flat), in each exchange's own market format such as BTCUSDT, XBT/EUR or BTC-USD. Without arguments: every exchange with its coin and market counts; with exchange: its markets per coin; with coin: that coin's markets on every exchange; with both: that one list.

coin.description: Only this coin, for example SOL

exchange.description: Cryptohopper exchange by name or key, for example Binance, Kraken, OKX, Coinbase or kraken2

name: get_signal_markets
title: Cryptohopper markets that get the signals
